user.title: Add a CatWandConnect robot
user.description: Enter the robot's IP address or .local name.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add a CatWandConnect robot
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the robot **{name}** to Home Assistant?

pin.title: Settings PIN
pin.description: **{name}** has a Settings PIN. Enter it so Home Assistant can change the robot's settings.

data_description.pin: The PIN set in the robot's Settings, 4 to 8 digits.

reauth_confirm.title: New Settings PIN
reauth_confirm.description: **{name}** no longer accepts the stored Settings PIN. Enter its new PIN so Home Assistant can change the robot's settings again.

data_description.pin: The PIN set in the robot's Settings, 4 to 8 digits.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the robot. Check the address and that the robot is on the same network.
error.locked_out: Too many wrong PINs. Wait {retry_after} seconds, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This robot is already added. Its address has been updated.
abort.cannot_connect: Can't reach the robot. Check that it is on and on the same network, then try again.
abort.firmware_too_old: This robot's firmware is too old for the integration. Update the robot to version {min_firmware} or later ([how to update]({update_url})), then add it again.
abort.reauth_successful: The Settings PIN has been updated.

play_not_calibrated.message: The robot didn't start the Play session: it isn't calibrated yet. Run the Calibration from the robot's interface.

play_busy.message: The robot didn't start the Play session: it is busy (stowing, calibrating or tuning a speed). Try again once it's done.

command_failed.message: Can't reach the robot. Check that it is on and on the same network.

wrong_pin.message: The robot no longer accepts the stored Settings PIN.

locked_out.message: Too many wrong PINs. Wait {retry_after} seconds, then try again.

firmware_too_old.title: {name}'s firmware is too old
firmware_too_old.description: **{name}** runs firmware {version}, too old for the integration. Update the robot to version {min_firmware} or later ([how to update]({update_url})), then reload the integration entry.
